title: Classical groups setting: G = isometry of an ε-Hermitian form, p ≠ 2
body_html:
Classical groups setting

Let $F_0$ be a $p$-adic field with $p \ne 2$ and let $F$ be either $F_0$ or a quadratic extension of $F_0$, with non-trivial involution $\overline{\;\cdot\;}$. Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional $F$-vector space equipped with a non-degenerate $\epsilon$-Hermitian form $\langle \cdot, \cdot \rangle$: $$\langle v, w \rangle = \epsilon\,\overline{\langle w, v \rangle}, \quad \epsilon \in \{+1, -1\}.$$

$G$ is the isometry group of $(V, \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle)$. With $\sigma$ the involution $g \mapsto (g^*)^{-1}$ on $\mathrm{GL}(V)$, $G = \mathrm{GL}(V)^\sigma$ with Lie algebra $\mathfrak{g} = \mathfrak{gl}(V)^\sigma$.

Endo-class data

Following [KSS, §9], an endo-class of $G$ is a pair $(\beta, \Phi)$:

  • $\beta \in \mathfrak{g}$ semisimple with $-k_F(\beta) > 0$, i.e. $(0, \beta)$ is a semisimple pair [KSS Def 9.1];
  • $\Phi$ a self-dual potential semisimple character on $(0, \beta)$ [KSS Defs 9.4–9.5].

Let $E := F[\beta]$. Since $\beta^* = -\beta$, $E$ decomposes as $$E = \bigoplus_{i^+ \in I^+}(E_{i^+} \oplus E_{i^-}) \oplus \bigoplus_{k \in I_0} E_k,$$ each $E_\bullet$ a field extension of $F$, with appropriate dual/self-dual structure.

Centralizer $M = G^\beta$

The Levi $M := G^\beta$ has the form $$M = \prod_i \mathrm{GL}_{E_{i^+}}(V_{i^+}) \times \prod_{k \in I_0} \mathrm{U}(V_k),$$ where the $V_k$ carry $\epsilon$-Hermitian forms with respect to $E_k / E_k^\circ$ (the fixed-point subfield).

This $M$ is the depth-zero target of the §8 main theorem applied to the semisimple type $(K_x, \kappa_x)$ defined in [[node:applications.classical_K_F_definition]].
